en: A black-and-white postcard showing the front facade of a large brick Roman Catholic church in neo‑Romanesque style. The church has a central tall, steep roof flanked by two tower-like structures with pointed roofs and belfry openings. A large circular window and several arched windows dominate the upper facade. In the foreground there is an iron fence with stone pillars topped by statues or crosses, and a wide paved approach. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.
